title: RFC005 §44.2 S2 Release Exposure Manifest
$comment: Closed envelope summarising the exposure one S2 run has recorded so far, derived ENTIRELY from the append-only exposure ledger (§44.2). Nothing here is asserted from memory or from a model: every set is the union over the ledger's records. Merging a new attempt into a release (§44.3's crash-safe resume) is a MONOTONIC union — the ledger only grows, so every lineage's exposure count and the total record count can only go up; a decrease is a ledger/attempt identity mismatch and is refused, not repaired. An attempt that crashed before recording any exposure legitimately contributes zero records: it still appears in `attempt_ids` because the RunAttemptManifest for it exists, but adds nothing to the sets.

release_id.$comment: make_id("release", "rfc005.s2-release-exposure-id/v1", payload without release_id and without the self-hash) — one release identity per (run, set of attempts, ledger state).

attempt_ids.$comment: The RunAttemptManifests this release was built from, sorted, unique.

exposure_ledger_root_hash.$comment: The ledger's root hash (domain_hash over {run_id, record_count, last_record_hash}) at the moment the release was built. The ledger is the authority; this is a pointer into it.

lineage_exposure.$comment: {lineage_root_id: views} where views = the number of ledger records naming that lineage as the drawn lineage root. Monotone under merge.

fragment_ids.$comment: Sorted union of every fragment id appearing in any record. Sorted, unique.

augmentation_ids.$comment: Sorted union of every augmentation id appearing in any record. Sorted, unique.
